t2.text: Key moments, each a live state of the same screen

why.text:
Agent first: the chat lives at the bottom of the right bar, answers arrive as cards, and every card draws its proof on the plan.

Built for site people: big targets, talk instead of type, any language in, answer in your language.

Transparent: every card says where the answer came from, how many model calls it took and what it cost. The reasoning tree shows each step.

All geometry and answers are real (swiss_dwellings site11420, DXF twin). Vision-check confidence values are samples until the Decisions API is wired.
